notes.title: King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! Details
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/4P1y6J02zvxcXYdgHSoQ4N/869073b11e96fa7baaaa4e642729a24e/KOM_Announce_IRONLAW_08_1920x420.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
Become the ultimate Contender, inspire the next generation of Dungeon Creators, and unleash your ridiculous during King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!

With the test arriving next week, we wanted to share additional details on what participants can expect. For players that missed the announcement, we provide a brief overview below. [url=https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-us/tester-sign-up]Sign up now[/url] for a chance to begin your road to stardom as the next Contender on the most exciting show in the universe. All you need is a weapon and a dream.

Learn more about the focus of the confidential, closed alpha and key test details. All feedback helps create an even better launch experience for all players.

[h2]Test Overview[/h2]
Fame, fortune, and gory, gory, glory await in King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! We’re excited to invite players on PC and Xbox Series X|S to the world of Loregok for the first time from December 4 through December 14.
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/4JIkTIxLjfpwb0PLSrF2Bp/89c10e93bf193cacbb0e39cd3145acc8/KOM_Xbox_Closed_Alpha_16x9_Titled_Hero_Art_1920x1080_CT-000012953_WEB.jpg[/img]
This invite-only, confidential alpha will give players in North America and Europe an early look at King of Meat, like a tantalizing pilot episode that gets even better after invaluable feedback (and a few casualties). Step into the role of fearless Contenders battling through ridiculous Dungeons, build devious creations, and outshine everyone with dazzling custom appearances.

[i]This is a confidential playtest of King of Meat. Your participation in this pre-release test is subject to the Non-Disclosure Agreement in Section 2.8 of our [url=http://www.amazon.com/help/ags/terms]Terms of Use[/url]. By participating, you agree to keep it strictly confidential. You may not disclose, in any form, content from this playtest. This means no streaming, posting of videos, or sharing images from this pre-release version of the game. Any breach of confidentiality will be treated seriously.
[/i]
[h3]Test Goals[/h3]
[previewyoutube=ehBAn64695o;full][/previewyoutube]

To help us deliver the best possible experience at launch, we'll review participant feedback on Create Mode, Dungeon gameplay, and more. We want to hear your feedback on as many features and systems as possible, including the number of thrown controllers. Our target is zero.

Feedback can be shared either through:
[list]
[*] The in-game feedback survey, accessible via the QR code on the main menu.
[*] A private Discord server used exclusively for this test. Players that have been selected for the confidential, closed alpha will receive a Discord invitation alongside their beta code via email. Only invited players will be able to access the private Discord server.
[/list]
[h3]Game Overview[/h3]
In the world of Loregok, where flocks of local dragons hunger for fame, neighborhood trolls crave funds to pay rent, and global corporate commercialism thirsts to quench its bottom line, comes a fresh source of raw entertainment — you.

[previewyoutube=xPmUWMUKWQY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Become the Ultimate Contender[/h3]
Some of you yearn for the spotlight as Contenders. Others may have taken a wrong turn on their way to the restroom. Those desperately seeking fame and fortune can enter joyfully unhinged Dungeons built by both the developers and the community. From outrageous enemy gauntlets to methodical puzzles, nothing is off the table in King of Meat.

[h3]Inspire the Next Generation of Dungeon Creators[/h3]
Take Dungeon creation into your own hands in Create Mode, where you're given the tools to create Dungeons of your dreams — and someone else’s nightmares. All of the Dungeons in King of Meat have been made with the same tools you'll use to create your own fiendish playgrounds. If you can play it, you can build it.

[h3]Unleash your Ridiculous[/h3]
Heroes get remembered, but legends never die, especially in Ironlaw Plaza where you can buy all of your favourite Contender merchandise. Develop your own style to stand out on the shelves and up at Komstruct Koliseum. Ironlaw Plaza features all of the latest trends in customization — like edible sausage hammers. You never know when your stomach will grumble during a rumble.

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z4mnmfs6j6sv/3O9KokyNKF8DG3lOtsPpU2/51c6deb7316caa3b0ebaa1edd8c6461f/KOM_Announce_Screenshots_WeaponsAndCharacters_3_1920.jpg[/img]
Here’s everything you need to know ahead of the confidential closed alpha:

If I already signed up to be a King of Meat tester, do I need to sign up again for the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!?
[list]
[*] No, you only need to sign up to become a play tester once. We will contact you if you have been selected to participate in King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! or any future tests.
[/list]
Which platforms are eligible to participate in the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!?
[list]
[*] King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! will be available on Steam (PC) and Xbox Series X|S.
[/list]
Which regions will participate in the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!?
[list]
[*] North America and Europe.
[/list]
Which languages will be supported in the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!?
[list]
[*] English audio and text will be supported in the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!. Additional languages will be available in the full release.
[/list]
Do I need Game Pass Core to participate in the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! on Xbox Series X|S?
[list]
[*] Players will not need an online subscription to participate in the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!.
[/list]
Can I play with a controller on PC during the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!?
[list]
[*] Yes, the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! will have support for controllers on PC.
[/list]
If I get access to the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!, can I stream or create content about the game?
[list]
[*] No, the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! is under NDA. Sharing, recording, or broadcasting any King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! test content or gameplay is strictly prohibited.
[/list]
Will progression from the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! carry over to the full release?
[list]
[*] Progression during playtests will not carry over to the final game.
[/list]
Do I need an internet connection to play?
[list]
[*] Yes, an internet connection is required to play King of Meat. 
[/list]
How will I be notified if I am selected to participate?
[list]
[*] If selected to participate, we will email you a code with instructions for downloading the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! by December 3. 
[*] Codes will be sent out in batches after December 3 too, so fear not Contender, you still might have an opportunity to test your skills in the Koliseum.
[/list]
Where can I get support for the King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA!?
[list]
[*] Accepted testers for King of Meat: Lights, Camera, ALPHA! will receive an invite to our private test Discord for support.
[*] You can also get support for Amazon Games iD through our Amazon Games iD Support channels.
[*] If you signed up via the Xbox Insider Program, please visit their website for support.
[/list]
What are the minimum and recommended PC specs?

Minimum System Requirements:
[list]
[*] OS: Windows 10
[*] Processor: Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
[*] Memory: 8 GB RAM
[*] Graphics: GTX 1060 5GB / RX470 4GB
[*] DirectX: Version 12
[*] Storage: 11 GB available space
[/list]

Recommended System Requirements:
[list]
[*] OS: Windows 10
[*] Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8700K or equivalent
[*] Memory: 8 GB RAM
[/list]

[url=https://www.kingofmeat.com/en-us/tester-sign-up]Sign up now[/url] for a chance to participate and stay tuned to this site, along with our social channels for future updates.
